prompt.en: What is the name given to the deportation of the Acadians between 1755 and 1763?
prompt.fr: Quel nom donne-t-on à la déportation des Acadiens entre 1755 et 1763?

explanation.en: Britain and France were at war, and from 1755 to 1763 over two-thirds of the Acadian people were forced off the land they called home. That hard chapter is remembered as the Great Upheaval. Acadians lived through it and held on to who they are.
explanation.fr: La Grande-Bretagne et la France étaient en guerre et, de 1755 à 1763, plus des deux tiers du peuple acadien ont été chassés de la terre qu'ils appelaient chez eux. On se souvient de cette dure épreuve sous le nom de Grand Dérangement. Les Acadiens y ont survécu et ont gardé leur identité.

source.quote: Despite this ordeal, known as the “Great Upheaval,” the Acadians survived and maintained their unique identity.

verification.evidence: Between 1755 and 1763, during the war between Britain and France, more than two-thirds of the Acadians were deported from their homeland. Despite this ordeal, known as the “Great Upheaval,” the Acadians survived and maintained their unique identity.
